FIRST EVER 6th Seat in Cybertruck

I took my Cybertruck to @CYBERTRUCKco  in Poway, CA and became the first owner in the world to get the brand-new 6th seat installed — right in the front row!

In this exclusive behind-the-scenes video, I sit down with the CybertruckCo team for a deep-dive interview on everything they considered when designing and building this seat: safety standards, comfort, materials, mounting hardware, fitment in the Cybertruck cabin, and how they made it work seamlessly on my truck.

If you’re a Cybertruck owner thinking about adding a 6th seat, this is the most detailed look you’ll find anywhere.

👉 CybertruckCo Website:
cybertruckco.com/product/cyb…
Email: sales@cybertruckco.com

Would you add a 6th seat to your Cybertruck? Let me know in the comments 👇
